proposals.claim: Sort eligible cells by ascending priority, then cell ID in JavaScript UTF-16 code-unit order. Keep the first cell for each credential group. If fallback consent is false, expose only the first remaining attempt. Price is freshness evidence, not a ranking input in this exercise.
Two eligible cells have different vendor names, so including both always provides independent fallback capacity, even if the credential-group values are identical.

A probe age exactly equal to the maximum should be stale: using strictly less than the configured maximum is safer. A timestamp one second in the future is fresh enough because its age is less than the limit.

A local test suite returned exit code zero. We can now say the production customer failure is fixed, without checking which tests ran, which source revision ran, or whether a production deployment occurred.

An operations note says some streaming calls are slow. Cut the global production timeout in half immediately. No stage-level timing, cancellation data, completion distribution, or customer impact sample accompanies the note.

A clean, recorded source revision and replay command that runs meaningful positive and negative controls can support a claim about the tested local contract. It does not, by itself, prove a live deployment or cover every failure mode.
